svg.title: Figure 3. Where the wire goes
svg.desc: Figure 3. Paired bar chart of the share of connections and the share of total wiring length. Neck-crossing connections: 7.5% of connections, 24.0% of wire, mean 606 µm. Any descending or ascending edge: 20.4% of connections, 38.7% of wire. Touching a hub (degree ≥ 67): 41.8% of connections, 46.4% of wire. None of these: 49.2% of connections, 37.3% of wire.
